# Villa JIJI (ვილა ჯიჯი)

> Family hotel in Bakuriani, Georgia: 8 self-catering rooms with kitchens and balconies, mountain and forest views, garden and a seasonal outdoor pool. Book directly at https://villajiji.com or call +995 596 90 40 60.

## Key facts
- Name: Villa JIJI (Georgian: ვილა ჯიჯი)
- Type: family hotel / guesthouse, open all year (ski season in winter, mountain holidays in summer)
- Address: Trialeti St, Bakuriani, Samtskhe-Javakheti, Georgia
- Map: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=41.7318533,43.5301119
- Phone and WhatsApp: +995 596 90 40 60
- Website and direct booking: https://villajiji.com (Georgian, English, Russian)
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/villajijibakuriani/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/villa.jiji/
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@villajiji
- Reception: every day 10:00–20:00

## Rooms (8 rooms in 4 types)
- Family room, 1 bedroom, up to 4+1 guests (rooms 1 and 4): two single beds in the bedroom; bunk bed and sofa bed in the living room; kitchenette; private bathroom; balcony over the front yard.
- Family room, 1 bedroom, up to 3+1 guests (rooms 3 and 5): two single beds; sofa bed; one extra bed possible; kitchenette; private bathroom; balcony (room 3 faces the mountains and forest, room 5 the front yard).
- Suite, 2 bedrooms, up to 5+1 guests (rooms 2 and 6): two single beds and one double bed; sofa bed; one extra bed possible; kitchen; private bathroom; balcony with mountain and forest views.
- Duplex, 2 bedrooms on two levels (rooms 7 and 8): two double beds, two sofa beds; kitchen; private bathroom; balcony with mountain and forest views.

## Good to know
- Meals: no restaurant or meals; every room has a kitchen or kitchenette. Shops are within walking distance, and Bakuriani has many cafes.
- Pets: allowed, please tell us in advance.
- Parking: free.
- Shared spaces: fireplace lounge, games room with billiards and a big screen, cinema corner with a projector, lounge with a bar, dining area.
- Pool: outdoor, seasonal (warm months).
- Ski passes can be bought at Villa JIJI; the ski lift is close by.
- Children: guests state the number of guests aged 10+ and of children under 10 when booking.
- Prices: per night, depend on the season, the room type and the number of guests. Current prices are shown on the website and in the website chat.
- Booking: send a request on the website, in the website chat, or in Facebook Messenger / Instagram. A request is free; the hotel confirms it by phone.

## По-русски
Villa JIJI — семейный отель в Бакуриани, ул. Триалети. 8 номеров с кухней и балконом, вид на горы и лес, каминный зал, бильярд, двор и сезонный бассейн. Без питания, бесплатная парковка, можно с животными. Бронирование: https://villajiji.com, тел.: +995 596 90 40 60.
